title: State ban on local rent control with narrow opt-in exception
requirement: No city or town may enact, maintain or enforce rent control of any kind. A city or town accepting Chapter 40P may regulate only on the chapter's conditions: compliance becomes voluntary after six months and the municipality must compensate owners.
key_value: rent control prohibited; compliance voluntary after 6 months
coverage_conditions: Cities and towns of the commonwealth; rent control is possible only in a municipality that accepts Chapter 40P and only within the limits set in Section 4.

applicability.other: only a city or town that accepts Chapter 40P may adopt rent control

exemptions: Local regulation cannot cover occupancy, services, evictions, condominium conversion or removal from regulation, nor any unit owned by a person or entity owning fewer than ten rental units, nor any unit with fair market rent over $400.
quoted_span: No city or town may enact, maintain or enforce rent control of any kind, except that any city or town that accepts this chapter may adopt rent control regulation that provides:
interaction: Local rent control is possible only if the city or town accepts this chapter

title: No inquiries or records on protected traits, publicly assisted and multiple dwelling housing
requirement: Owners, lessees, brokers, assignees, managing agents and condominium or cooperative unit-owner organizations may not cause any written or oral inquiry or record about a prospective tenant's protected characteristics.
coverage_conditions: Publicly assisted, multiple dwelling or contiguously located housing accommodations, and organizations of unit owners in a condominium or housing cooperative.

applicability.other: publicly assisted or multiple dwelling or contiguously located housing accommodations

citation: G.L. c. 151B, § 4: prohibited inquiries and records, publicly assisted and multiple dwellings
quoted_span: to cause to be made any written or oral inquiry or record concerning the race, religious creed, color, national origin, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, which shall not include persons whose sexual orientation involves minor children as the sex object, age, genetic information, ancestry or marital status of the person seeking to rent or lease or buy any such accommodation

title: No inquiries or records on protected traits, other covered housing
requirement: Owners, lessees, sublessees, brokers, assignees and managing agents of other covered housing accommodations may not cause any written or oral inquiry or record about a prospective tenant's protected characteristics.
coverage_conditions: Other covered housing accommodations and land described in subsections 10 to 13 of section one, including condominium and housing cooperative unit-owner organizations.

applicability.other: other covered housing accommodations under section one, subsections 10 to 13

exemptions: Leasing of a single apartment or flat in a two family dwelling whose other occupancy unit is occupied by the owner as his residence.
citation: G.L. c. 151B, § 4: prohibited inquiries and records, other covered housing accommodations
quoted_span: to cause to be made any written or oral inquiry or record concerning the race, color, religious creed, national origin, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, which shall not include persons whose sexual orientation involves minor children as the sex object, age, genetic information, ancestry, marital status, veteran status or membership in the armed services, blindness, hearing impairment or other handicap or because such person possesses a trained dog guide as a consequence of blindness or hearing impairment, of the person seeking to rent or lease or buy any such accommodation or land

title: Source-of-income protection for public assistance and housing subsidy recipients
requirement: A person furnishing credit, services or rental accommodations may not discriminate against an individual because that person receives federal, state or local public assistance or a housing subsidy, or because of any requirement of such a program.
coverage_conditions: Any person furnishing credit, services or rental accommodations; protects recipients of federal, state or local public assistance, including medical assistance, and tenants receiving housing subsidies or rental assistance.
citation: G.L. c. 151B, § 4: public assistance and housing subsidy recipients
quoted_span: For any person furnishing credit, services or rental accommodations to discriminate against any individual who is a recipient of federal, state, or local public assistance, including medical assistance, or who is a tenant receiving federal, state, or local housing subsidies, including rental assistance or rental supplements
